name: Optical Fibre & Glass Preform for AI Data Centres
scope: AI data-centre and hyperscaler build-outs have made optical fibre (and the glass preform it is drawn from) a tight global supply item, and Indian makers have board-approved large fibre/cable/preform capex (HFCL, Birla Furukawa/Universal Cables, Vindhya Telelinks, Sterlite Tech); PARTLY DISCOVERED -- Sterlite Tech (~+350% YTD by May 2026) and HFCL (~+134%) have already re-rated hard and Upstox-type pieces group them, so the earlier angles are preform backward integration (2028) and the less-re-rated mid/small caps (Vindhya Telelinks, Universal Cables, Finolex).
questions: What is driving the global optical fibre and preform shortage (AI scale-out and scale-across networks, hyperscaler orders, ribbon/high-fibre-count and specialty cables), and how durable is it versus past telecom cycles?
Why is preform the real bottleneck, how much of India's fibre output depends on imported preform, and how does backward integration change margins?

What have HFCL, Sterlite Technologies, Universal Cables (Birla Furukawa JV), Vindhya Telelinks and Finolex Cables each announced or commissioned (capex, fkm and preform tonnes capacity, timelines, hyperscaler orders)?
Which of these companies have confirmed export or hyperscaler customers versus mainly domestic BharatNet/telecom demand?
How much of each company's revenue and profit is actually tied to data-centre/AI fibre versus legacy telecom, power cables or other segments?
How much has each stock already re-rated over 6-12 months, and how much of it is attributed to this theme in media and broker coverage?
Which names are still early (small/mid caps, preform leg) versus already priced in (Sterlite Tech, HFCL)? Compare valuations against order books.
What are the execution, funding and balance-sheet risks (large capex, project delays to 2028, Sterlite's leverage, Birla Furukawa's Rs 4,800 cr plan)?
What are the pricing and competition risks (Chinese oversupply, Corning/Prysmian/YOFC capacity adds, anti-dumping duties, fibre price normalisation)?
What are the near-term catalysts (quarterly order inflows, preform plant milestones, new hyperscaler contracts, duty/policy actions)?

fibre_and_cable_makers: Scaled fibre/cable producers already winning data-centre and hyperscaler orders; largely re-rated
preform_backward_integration: Companies with announced capex for domestic optical fibre preform, the upstream bottleneck
specialty_cable_smallcaps: Smaller names expanding specialty optical cable capacity, less re-rated
